info.name: SoundScape API - Endpoints and Live CRUD
info.description: SoundScape Fastify API collection aligned with docs/openapi.yaml and src/routes/api. Run folders in order. Folder 01 is a self-contained contributor CRUD with no admin token. Folder 02 covers all 21 business endpoints plus persistence, analytics and error checks. Use a disposable development database. Set baseUrl and adminToken in a local environment; no credentials are included in this public-safe collection. Collection variables hold only baseUrl; runtime IDs and dates use local pm.variables. No payment endpoints exist in this project.

item.name: 01 - Contributors CRUD (no admin token)
item.description: Standalone live CRUD: creates a unique synthetic contributor, reads it, updates it, reads the persisted update, deletes it, and verifies 404. Requires MongoDB. Does not require admin credentials.

item.name: 02 - All business endpoints (admin token required)
item.description: Ordered integration workflow covering all 21 business method/path pairs. Creates a neighborhood, contributor, school and reading; exercises analytics; removes only the created test records in dependency order. Set adminToken locally. Coordinates are a synthetic fixture in Warsaw, not user location.

exec: pm.test("Heatmap includes the created reading and hourly statistics", () => { const n = pm.response.json().neighborhoods.find(x => x.neighborhoodId === pm.variables.get('neighborhoodId')); pm.expect(n).to.exist; pm.expect(n.readingsCount).to.eql(1); pm.expect(n.averageDecibelLevel).to.eql(65); pm.expect(n.hourly).to.have.lengthOf(1); });
